messages:
Iris (Finance): Quick questionwe got an Azure Marketplace settlement with a single negative credit line labeled 'ADJUST-CR-2024' that is allocated to reseller 'northbridge-partners' but there's no customer or subscription id. The amount is -$6,750. Any ideas?
Noah (Billing): That's unusual. If it's a reseller-level adjustment Azure sometimes posts a single credit with partner_reference only. Can you paste the settlement snippet?
Iris (Finance): Snippet in ticket: 
provider: azure_marketplace
partner: northbridge-partners
line_id: 98765
ref: ADJUST-CR-2024
amount: -6750.00
notes: "marketplace credit applied"
(no subscription_id, no order_id)
SettleBot: Imported AZ-SETTLEMENT-2024-05-31. Reconciler: UNMAPPED_RESELLER_CREDIT for partner northbridge-partners.
Samir (Partner Ops): Did we have any chargeback disputes with that partner in May? Could be a lump-sum reconciliation credit. I'll check past tickets.
Lydia (Accounting): From GAAP perspective we'd treat an unmapped reseller credit as contra-revenue only with vendor confirmation. We should avoid recognizing it as a customer refund until mapping is verified.
Noah (Billing): Can we hold the settlement application? We normally auto-apply credits with matching subscription_id. Since there's none, set this to manual review and pause payout for the reseller for now.
Iris (Finance): Agree. I'll open a vendor clarification request. Samir, please include the original settlement CSV row and ask for either the original meter payload or a manifest mapping ADJUST-CR-2024 to internal order ids. Also request whether this correction applies to a past invoice or is a marketplace-level credit to the reseller.
Samir (Partner Ops): Draft message to partner: "We observed ADJUST-CR-2024 in your Azure settlement (line 98765) with no subscription_id. Please confirm mapping (customer subscription_id or order_id) and whether this should be applied to a specific invoice. If we do not receive mapping within 5 business days, Finance will treat this as vendor-level adjustment and post contra per policy"
Lydia (Accounting): 5 business days OK. I'll prepare the contra JE template and a note for tax team — we need to confirm tax reclaim procedure if it's a true refund.
Noah (Billing): I'll add a reconciler rule to block auto-apply for any settlement row that has partner_reference pattern 'ADJUST-*' without a subscription_id. Low-risk change.
Iris (Finance): Good. Also flag finance leadership if partner doesn't respond in 5 days.
Samir (Partner Ops): Reached out to partner via email and account Slack. They acknowledged and said they're investigating and will provide a manifest within 48 hours. Updating ticket.
SettleBot: Case opened CASE-AZ-9981 assigned to Partner Ops.
Lydia (Accounting): Preparing reserve JE for the $6,750 so it doesn't impact month-end revenue recognition.
Noah (Billing): Holding settlement application and payout. Will unhold once partner confirms mapping.
Iris (Finance): Thanks. Keep this thread updated once partner sends the manifest or confirms it's a reseller-level credit.
Samir (Partner Ops): Will do. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
